title: Quant-iT dsDNA Broad-Range Assay Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Configure pipette mounts
steps.instruction: In the protocol customization fields, select the mount (left or right) for the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette and for the P10 Multi‑Channel Pipette.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Provide any required parameters (e.g., sample identifiers) in the input fields before generating the protocol.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the “Download your protocol” button to save the JSON protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place labware on the OT‑2 deck according to the map:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (15 mL) – load reagent mix (buffer + dye) into well A1.
Slot 3: Micronics 96‑Tube Plate (MP52757S‑Y20) containing DNA samples.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, run the calibration routine for the deck, tip racks, and both the P300 and P10 multi‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Run the assay protocol
steps.instruction: Start the protocol in the OT‑App; the robot will:

substeps.instruction: Use the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette with 300 µL tips to dispense the reagent mix (buffer + dye) into each well of the 96‑well plate.
Switch to the P10 Multi‑Channel Pipette with 10 µL tips and add 1 µL of DNA from each corresponding tube in the 96‑tube plate to the matching well.
Proceed with any incubation or read steps defined in the downloaded protocol.

steps.title: Press Run to execute
steps.instruction: On the OT‑App screen, click the “Run” button to begin the automated execution of the protocol.
